in_hebrew.name: בִּרְאָם
in_hebrew.meaning: בִּרְאָם - name means 'exalted, elevated' or 'divine greatness' in Hebrew
in_hebrew.long_meaning: בִּרְאָם - name means 'exalted, elevated' or 'divine greatness' in Hebrew, originating from the root 'bara' (בָּרָא) meaning 'to create, to make' and 'el' (אֵל) meaning 'God, divine greatness', in Hebrew culture, the name Byrom symbolizes someone who is highly esteemed and respected in faith, reflecting the biblical concept of humility and the importance of recognizing one's place before God (Proverbs 22:4), also referencing the divine creation of humanity (Genesis 1:27) and the value of human life as a creation of God

in_greek.name: Βύρωμ
in_greek.meaning: Βύρωμ - name means 'exalted, elevated' or 'divine greatness' in Greek
in_greek.long_meaning: Βύρωμ - name means 'exalted, elevated' or 'divine greatness' in Greek, originating from the root 'baros' (βαρός) meaning 'heavy, weighty' and 'ouranos' (οὐρανός) meaning 'heaven, sky', in early Christian tradition, the name Byrom signifies someone who is lifted up spiritually, emphasizing the Christian concept of spiritual growth and the importance of looking towards the heavens (Matthew 5:48) and the kingdom of heaven (Matthew 6:10)

in_latin.name: Byromus
in_latin.meaning: Byromus - name means 'exalted, elevated' or 'divine greatness' in Latin
in_latin.long_meaning: Byromus - name means 'exalted, elevated' or 'divine greatness' in Latin, derived from the Latin words 'byros' meaning 'exalted' and 'mus' meaning 'mouse', in Latin culture, the name Byrom symbolizes someone who is elevated above the ordinary, reflecting the classical concept of virtus (virtue) and the importance of striving for excellence, also referencing the idea of spiritual ascension in the Christian tradition (Hebrews 6:4-6)
